title: Smart Data Models - TM Forum Open APIs - BalanceActionHistory
description: A history of the following operations performed on the bucket: TopupBalance, AdjustBalance and TransferBalance (TM Forum TMF654 Prepay Balance Management 4.0.0, Swagger definition BalanceActionHistory; attribute names kept verbatim except the NGSI-LD reserved terms / JSON-LD keywords renamed with a tmf prefix (id, @type, @baseType, @schemaLocation, ...); deprecated attributes left out.)

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity: urn:ngsi-ld:BalanceActionHistory:<tmfId>.

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'BalanceActionHistory'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the original source of the entity data.

Renamed from TMF 'id' (NGSI-LD reserved term); the NGSI-LD id is urn:ngsi-ld:BalanceActionHistory:<tmfId>. Unique Identifier for the resource
